calls.title: Jess Martin
calls.summary: Jess Martin's career has transitioned from digital marketing at O'Reilly to leadership roles in tech startups, emphasizing strategic agency management and effective digital campaigns. At D2IQ, she brought campaigns in-house to enhance efficiency after recognizing poor agency performance, utilizing her expertise in Google Ads and ABM strategies. Jess consistently prioritized high-quality leads over raw MQLs, implementing lead scoring in HubSpot to increase pipeline predictability. She addressed challenges in website project delays and adapted to multiple leadership changes, all while balancing brand marketing efforts with digital tactics at Orca. Insights on market positioning showcased her ability to navigate competitive dynamics in the cloud security sector, emphasizing educational marketing strategies to differentiate products.
calls.keywords: Digital Marketing, Lead Scoring, ABM Campaigns, Cloud Security, PR Strategy, Marketing Analytics
